rotating_tips: Message with @name or #group — tap a chat row to focus a target
@ai your question — PointChat AI (only your private AI thread)
Use the location button in the composer to share GPS
Voice notes: ±1s buttons and waveform tap to seek
Type @ to see people; type / for slash commands
ai_knowledge: PointChat supports DMs (@username), groups (#groupname), voice messages, photos/files, and location sharing via the location button in the composer. /newbot Name opens creating a custom bot. @ai talks to PointChat AI in the user's private self-chat thread. Custom bots reply when messaged. Slash commands: /myprofile, /setting, /newbot. AI responses do not use web search or Google grounding (text-only model).
